metadata.name: Retro Slide to Unlock
metadata.description: A skeuomorphic lock screen inspired by early-2010s phones: live clock, drawn water wallpaper, a shimmering slide to unlock knob, camera peek, and working home and sleep buttons with music controls, in an optional classic phone frame. Fully props-driven and keyboard accessible.
metadata.author: aakashmehra
